# Laravel Extended Validation
> A collection of useful validation rules rejected from Laravel core, implemented the Laravel way.

## Docs

- https://mrpunyapal.github.io/laravel-extended-validation/configuration: Configuration
- https://mrpunyapal.github.io/laravel-extended-validation/installation: Installation
- https://mrpunyapal.github.io/laravel-extended-validation/: Laravel Extended Validation
- https://mrpunyapal.github.io/laravel-extended-validation/rules: Rules Reference
- https://mrpunyapal.github.io/laravel-extended-validation/usage: Usage
